description: Source code for a terminal line editing library implementing input handling, window resizing, UTF-8 support, and terminal control sequences.

methods.name: nsyms
methods.description: Counts symbols in buffer, considering UTF-8 if enabled.

methods.name: is_utf8_cont
methods.description: Checks if a byte is a UTF-8 continuation byte.

methods.name: utf8_move_left
methods.description: Moves cursor left over UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: utf8_move_right
methods.description: Moves cursor right over UTF-8 characters.

methods.name: update_window_size
methods.description: Updates terminal window size and triggers resize event.

methods.name: check_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a character is a UTF-8 start byte.

methods.name: pos_add
methods.description: Adds a delta to cursor position.

methods.name: pos_add_ofs
methods.description: Adds offset-based position to cursor position.

methods.name: pos_add_newline
methods.description: Moves cursor position to next line.

methods.name: __pos_add_string
methods.description: Adds string length to cursor position, handling escape sequences.

methods.name: pos_add_string
methods.description: Adds string to cursor position, handling newlines.

methods.name: set_cursor
methods.description: Moves terminal cursor to specified position.

methods.name: display_output_string
methods.description: Outputs string to terminal and updates cursor position.

methods.name: display_update_line
methods.description: Updates display of a line buffer.

methods.name: display_update
methods.description: Updates entire display based on current state.

methods.name: move_word_left
methods.description: Moves cursor left by a word.

methods.name: move_word_right
methods.description: Moves cursor right by a word.

methods.name: process_esc
methods.description: Processes escape sequences for cursor movement and window resize.

methods.name: uline_poll
methods.description: Polls for input and processes characters.

methods.name: uline_free
methods.description: Frees resources associated with uline state.
